top_signals.title: Stocks Fall, Oil Rises as Iran Refuses to Soften Demands; US, China to Cut Tariffs
top_signals.summary: US equity futures and Treasuries fall as uncertainties around the conflict between the US and Iran push oil higher and lifts concerns around inflation. Tehran says it's sticking to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz that President Trump has rejected. The US and China release a detailed plan to cut tariffs on about $30 billion of imports from each nation. Nvidia introduces a new double-layered AI security system that will keep agents from going awry. Aneeka Gupta of Wisdomtree joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the market pricing in long-term uncertainty. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Turkey Releases Comedian Jailed Over Stand-Up Show That Drew 15 Million Views
top_signals.summary: Turkish comedian Deniz Goktas was released from prison on Monday after spending nearly three months in pretrial detention over remarks in a stand-up show that went viral on YouTube.
